about.title: About me
about.p1: Information Technology graduate from the Faculty of Sciences, University of Lisbon (January 2026), with a strong interest in information security and cybersecurity.
about.p2: My academic projects gave me hands-on experience with secure client-server applications, TLS, encryption, digital signatures and message authentication codes. I enjoy investigating how systems behave, spotting weaknesses and finding practical ways to fix them.
about.p3: I am curious, responsible and organised.
